reason: My broker already gives me AI help for free, and I already ask Claude before I trade, so I don't see why I'd pay a monthly fee for an app that's still on demo money and doesn't even have a broker yet. The pet is cute, but cute isn't a reason to move my actual portfolio.
objection: Why would I move real money to a new app with no broker named and no price, just to pay a subscription for something Robinhood and Public are adding for free?
would_change_my_mind: A named, regulated broker partner with SIPC coverage and a flat price under about $5 a month, plus an agent that clearly beats what my current broker's free AI does, shown with my own numbers in the demo first.
